mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.5 million units signals strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST > 1.5 million.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a supply shock, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO MoM < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where RSAFS MoM < -1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a decrease in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals a tightening monetary policy with controlled inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening monetary policy with controlled inflation
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases and CPIAUCSL decreases.
